title: Bonk.fun warns hackers hijacked domain in wallet-drainer attack
summary: Bonk.fun warned users not to use its site after attackers hijacked the domain and pushed a fake wallet-draining prompt.

title: New Zealand regulator says NZDD stablecoin not a financial product
summary: Law firm MinterEllisonRuddWatts, which acted on behalf of the stablecoin’s issuer, says the designation of the token is an important step for regulatory clarity.

title: AI agent payment volumes lower than reported, but adoption is growing: a16z
summary: Andreessen Horowitz partner Noah Levine says AI agents made $1.6 million in payments in the past month, which “is not a big number, but the infrastructure being built around it is.”

title: Kalshi preemptively sues Iowa, claiming risk of enforcement action
summary: Kalshi claims in a preemptive lawsuit that there is “a substantial risk” that Iowa will take action against it after a meeting it had with state regulators.

title: Stablecoin yields will bring fresh money to US banks: White House's Witt
summary: Global demand for the US dollar is “massive,” and stablecoin yields will only bring more interest to the currency, argued the White House crypto chief.

title: BoE open to scrapping stablecoin limit idea after backlash
summary: Industry groups have criticized the UK’s proposed stablecoin holding limits, arguing they would signal that the UK is hostile to crypto and stifle innovation.

title: Metaplanet forms new venture firm as it expands Bitcoin playbook
summary: Metaplanet said the new firm would support Japan-based Bitcoin projects in the payments and lending space in addition to stablecoins and tokenization-focused startups.

title: MediaTek patches bug enabling crypto seed theft in just 45 seconds
summary: Ledger’s white-hat security team said it found a flaw in MediaTek's secure boot chain that can be used to steal sensitive information from certain Android devices.

title: Binance.US names new CEO as crypto exchange eyes expansion
summary: Stephen Gregory, a former compliance executive at CEX.IO and Gemini, has taken over as CEO of Binance.US, a crypto exchange that was once a target of a long-running SEC lawsuit.

title: Ghana greenlights 11 crypto companies for regulatory sandbox
summary: Ghana’s SEC could grant a full license to sandbox participants as early as six months, provided that their products are market-ready and that they tick all regulatory boxes.
